newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers quiet amid U.S., Europe holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers quiet amid U.S., Europe holiday.

text.p: The Singapore bunker market was quiet with few enquiries on Monday as the U.S. and European markets are closed for a holiday, traders said.
Competition was strong because enquiries were few and some suppliers slashed offers to get business, offering the 380-cst grade at a low of $95 per tonne, traders said.

Many majors said they would not lower offers when the cargo market is firm. "Some majors did not even bother to offer," said one trader. The 380-cst level was quoted at $97/$98 while the 180-cst was at about $102/$104. MDO and gas oil were at around $193 and $203 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
